_comment: T3 authoritative consumer map — DERIVED from the executed census (theme2-s1-census.json) and the code as shipped, superseding §4's hand-authored table (protocol v7.4). Every entry names the PUBLIC entry the harness drives, what dormant must do (T5's parity), and what enabled-against-unknown must do (§4's kill: silent success or a gestation stamp).

stampers.note: owner-ruled explicit stamp; dormant default is the LITERAL gestation (SQL-default parity), not current_phase()

stampers.enabled_unknown: PhaseUnknownRefusal; no row; try_write_turn converts it to the shadow no-op on the reply path
typed refusal refusal_code=phase_unknown_<reason>; no plan rows
PhaseUnknownRefusal; no row (gate 20/21: the actual SQL sink; authority at the sink)

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: is_born()==False keeps gated paths closed; unreadable counts as unborn — fail toward privacy
readers_and_exemptions.dormant: legacy is_born(); unreadable counts as unborn — paths stay closed

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: DELIBERATE opposite sign: an unreadable ledger counts as BORN so the R11 exemption stays expired. Refusing is the safe direction for an exemption; do not 'fix' this to match the stampers.
readers_and_exemptions.dormant: legacy OR of signals; unreadable counts as BORN — exemption stays expired

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: reads stored values only; exercised read-only in the positive control
readers_and_exemptions.dormant: reads stored values; no phase logic of its own

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: §10: NULL→gestation on every open, idempotent, historical annotation not a fresh stamp; proceeds even on unknown
readers_and_exemptions.dormant: NULL→gestation normalization on every open, dormant and enabled alike (§10: historical annotation, not a fresh stamp)

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: writes the sentinel 'benchmark' directly into isolated benchmark collections, bypassing store(); it can never write gestation/lived, so it cannot misdate a life. ADJUDICATED EXEMPT pending gate review; the harness pins the sentinel so drift into a real phase is caught.
readers_and_exemptions.dormant: writes the 'benchmark' sentinel directly to mm.raw; dormant identical

readers_and_exemptions.semantics: RULED + WIRED (gate 21): with S1 enabled, the readiness panel paints a resolver-unknown ledger RED with the reason, and LatchBlocked reads as 'joins but latch blocked'. A readiness display saying gestation about an unvouchable ledger is the A6 misreport in cockpit clothing.

census_join._rule: every memory_phase writer in the derived census either appears here mapped to its T3 row, is a module-level selftest site (::@N — ruled IN for T4, not independent T3 consumers, gate 20), or fails tests/test_t3_map_join.py

readers.scripts/birth_ceremony.py::run_transacti: OWNER-ONLY (the birth transaction itself; never driven by a witness)
readers.scripts/replay_harness.py::_run_multi_tu: SELF-WITNESS-TOOLING (the pre-S1 probe harness reads self-history through the ledger; a witness instrument, not a production consumer; it stamps nothing)

census_join._reader_rule: every birth_meta_reader in the derived census maps to a T3 row, to SELF (the resolver's own accessor), or to OWNER-ONLY (the birth ceremony); anything else fails tests/test_t3_map_join.py
